inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E = 9M-2026 actual $2,363.3m (10-Q Q3-2026) + Q4-2026 guidance midpoint $1,015m ($1.00-1.03bn, 8-K 2026-10-29). Growth path compounds from FY2027.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted 206.3m per Q3-2026 release: 193.1m basic (146.96m Class A + 46.15m Class B at 2026-09-30, 10-Q) + 9.6m options + 3.56m RSU/PRSU. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-charge it. The $340m of 9M-2026 buybacks is the cash mechanism keeping the count flat and is already deducted as SBC.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and equivalents $1,357.6m + marketable securities $1,675.8m at 2026-09-30 (10-Q balance sheet). No borrowings; revolving credit facility undrawn. Operating lease liabilities (~$28m ROU) left out of net debt because the lease cost is inside EBITDA (one lease treatment).
inputs.reported_fcf_basis: TTM Oct-2025 to Sep-2026 = FY2025 $684.2m + 9M-2026 $934.5m - 9M-2025 $420.6m (company definition: OCF less purchases of property and equipment).
inputs.sbc_source: TTM of the company's combined 'Stock-based compensation expense and related taxes' line in the adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation: FY2025 $387.1m (10-K p.~1961) + 9M-2026 $322.1m - 9M-2025 $296.1m (10-Q Q3-2026 line 1681) = $413.2m. Cash-flow add-back alone is $385.8m TTM (343.2 + 300.6 - 258.0); the two lines are NOT summed because the combined reconciliation figure already absorbs the net-share-settlement tax cost ($68.5m TTM in financing). Prior model summed the two ($420.8m); this run uses the company's combined figure per the method.
inputs.interest_income_note: TTM 'Other income (expense), net' = FY2025 $86.7m + 9M-2026 $75.4m - 9M-2025 $63.7m = $98.4m, which the 10-Q says consists primarily of interest income on cash and marketable securities. Stripped because net cash ($3.03bn) is 4.4x the owner-FCF base and is added to equity separately.
inputs.owner_fcf_fy2026e_note: 9M-2026 owner FCF $537.0m (934.5 - 322.1 - 75.4) + Q4E ~$336m (guided EBITDA $495m less ~$150m SBC, ~$5m tax, ~$5m capex, ~$0 D&A net, ~$0 lease, and a ~$140m FY receivables build pro-rated). Year-1 (FY2027) base owner FCF of ~$1,165m (28% margin) vs FY2026E 25.8% reflects +1.4pp EBITDA margin and a smaller working-capital drag as growth slows.
inputs.buyback_note: 9M-2026 repurchases of Class A common stock $340.0m (Q1 $5.0m, Q2 $234.6m, Q3 $100.4m at ~$149.81 avg); ~$660m of the $1bn authorisation remains. Authorised != spent: only the cash outflow is recorded.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD discount rate. 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.9 x 5% ERP = ~13.7% cost of equity; no debt so WACC = CoE. Base 12% (the prior judgment, held) sits between a pure CAPM read and a size/quality discount for a $19bn S&P 500 net-cash company; bull 11% / bear 13.5% carried from the prior model unchanged.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (US GAAP, ~$28m ROU asset) expensed inside EBITDA; lease liabilities excluded from net debt. One treatment.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating consumer-internet company, ~95% advertising). UPDATE of the 2026-08-28 hand-built FCF-growth model (price refreshed 2026-10-18 at $156.14) after the Q3-2026 print and the Google search-referral warning. Price is the 2026-10-30 regular close, not an after-hours print. Owner FCF basis: SBC incl. related taxes expensed, interest income stripped, count held flat at 206.3m fully diluted. Cash tax: full US valuation allowance still in place; cash taxes are ~1.5% of pre-tax income and the 10-Q flags a likely VA release within 12 months (GAAP benefit, no cash effect), so the cash-tax path ramps to 23% over five years as NOLs and SBC deductions are consumed. Working-capital capture is NEGATIVE (-12% base): Reddit is an ad business whose receivables grow with revenue (9M-2026 AR +$139m, prepaids +$26m vs AP/accruals +$60m on an $886m revenue increase = -12%); the prior model's +17% was the prepaid-subscription sign and has been corrected (methodology item in the reconciliation bridge).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2027 growth (Q4-2026 guide 38-42% glided down); historical revenue CAGR of 48.9% (FY2022-25) is not a usable forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Only four fiscal years since the March-2024 IPO; EPS, equity and owner FCF all cross zero (losses to FY2024, profit from FY2025) and FY2024 carries the ~$595m IPO RSU cliff-vest SBC charge plus a $189.9m one-off equity-settlement tax, so EPS/equity/FCF CAGRs are not meaningful. Revenue is the only clean series. Owner FCF (reported FCF less SBC-and-related-taxes less other income) is -187 / -703 / +210 for FY2023-25 and +687 TTM.
historical_growth.notes: SBC-adjusted owner FCF turned durably positive only in FY2025 ($210m, 9.6% of revenue) and is $687m TTM (22.2%); the 12-month jump is an operating-leverage inflection, not a compounding base. Reported FCF overstates owner cash by 43% TTM ($1,198m vs $687m): SBC-and-taxes $413m and other income $98m.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +22%: Q4-2026 guide is +38-42% and the quarterly rate has fallen 61% -> 53% -> ~40% in two quarters; with DAUq likely down low-double-digits from Q4 on lost Google referrals, FY2027 is modelled as DAUq roughly -5% on average and ARPU still +~28% (Reddit Max, lower-funnel formats, US ARPU +53% in Q3). Years 2-10 glide 16% -> 5%; year-10 revenue ~$9.2bn, i.e. ~130-140m DAUq at ~$65 annual ARPU. Prior path (20,18,16,14,12,11,10,9,8,7) raised in year 1 on the Q3 beat and Q4 guide but lowered from year 2 because the search-referral collapse is structural evidence against the top-of-funnel that path assumed.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC) 46% FY2027 vs FY2026E ~44.6% (Q4 guide 48-50% at seasonal peak); 52% mature. SBC incl. taxes 14.5% -> 7.5% (FY2026 guide low-to-mid teens; TTM 13.4%, Q3 15.2%). Unchanged from the prior model except year 1 (+1pp on the Q4 guide).

scenario_narratives.base: Monetisation keeps outrunning a flat-to-shrinking user base, but not by as much as 2025-26. Google AI Overviews/AI Mode take a low-double-digit bite out of logged-out DAUq in Q4-2026 and the base does not recover it; US DAUq drifts down ~2-5% a year while the logged-in/app cohort (>80% of monetisation) holds. Revenue +22% in FY2027 (vs the +38-42% Q4 guide, the 61->53->40 deceleration continued) on ARPU gains from Reddit Max, shopping/app-install and video formats and international (ARPU ~18% of US), then glides to 5%. Adjusted EBITDA 46% -> 52%; SBC incl. taxes 14.5% -> 7.5% of revenue and fully expensed (~$600m in FY2027, ~37% of reported FCF - the single largest owner-FCF deduction). Data licensing (~$48m/qtr, ~5% of revenue) is assumed renewed at roughly flat dollars inside the growth path - no step-up for usage-based pricing and no loss. Receivables growth is a -12% working-capital drag on each year's revenue increase. Net cash of $3.03bn (~16% of the $18.9bn market cap) is added at face value and its ~$98m of interest income stripped from the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The logged-in pivot works: tests in non-US markets in Q4-2026 convert mobile-web and search-referred visitors into app/logged-in users, DAUq stabilises in 1H27 and returns to growth in 2H27 on international (+24% y/y today) and Reddit Answers habit; US ARPU keeps compounding on Reddit Max (adoption >3x QoQ in Q3) and lower-funnel formats (+95%). Revenue +30% FY2027 (the Q4 guide beaten as Q3 beat its guide by ~$30m) decaying to 8% by year 10 (~$13bn). Adjusted EBITDA scales to 57% on a 91% gross margin and fixed cost base; SBC falls to 6% of revenue. Google and OpenAI licensing renew on usage-based terms and the Anthropic suit sets a paid-access precedent - modelled only as a modestly higher growth path, not a separate licensing step-up. Still SBC-expensed; the street basis is the memo.
scenario_narratives.bear: The Google search funnel does not come back. Referrals keep falling at the October pace (>1m/week), logged-out DAUq (59% of the total) contracts through 2027, US DAUq falls high-single-digits and inventory shortfalls (the CFO already could not deliver some September bookings) cap ad delivery. The logged-in wall costs reach before it buys targeting. Google declines to renew data licensing on Reddit's terms (~$60m/yr lost) and OpenAI reprices down. Revenue +3% in FY2027 (DAUq ~-15%, ARPU ~+18%), -3% in FY2028, then 2-3% a year - a real revenue hit, not a slower climb. Adjusted EBITDA compresses to 37-40% as the cost base built for 50% growth meets flat revenue, recovering to 43% by year 10 after restructuring; SBC stays 16% -> 11.5% of revenue because the share price fall raises grant counts for the same dollar comp. WACC 13.5%, terminal growth 2.5%, 15x FCF cap. Net cash still provides a floor: the bear value is ~26% cash.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from 25% to 35%: the central risk is a single-channel dependency (Google search referrals) that management itself quantified as a possible low-double-digit DAUq decline in Q4, with US DAUq already -2%, and the mitigation (a primarily logged-in product) is an unproven pivot. Bull cut from 25% to 20% because it needs three independent things - the logged-in pivot, continued 30%+ ARPU gains and licensing renewals - to go right at once. Base 45%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Updated 2026-10-31 on the Q3-2026 print. The thesis has moved from 'monetisation outgrowing users' to 'can monetisation outgrow a shrinking, search-dependent user base'. The model charges SBC in full (~$413m TTM incl. taxes, 37% of reported FCF), strips the ~$98m of interest on the $3.03bn cash pile and adds that cash back once, holds the fully diluted count flat at 206.3m, and - a correction to the prior build - treats working capital as the receivables drag an ad business actually carries rather than a prepaid-subscription inflow. Growth is anchored on the Q4 guide and a glide path, not on the 50-60% 2025-26 rates. The bear case models an actual DAU and ad-revenue hit (revenue +3% then -3%) with data licensing lost, and is weighted 35%. Net cash is ~$14.70/share and the bear value is roughly a quarter cash.
key_risks_to_valuation: Google AI Overviews/AI Mode: referrals fell >1m/week in October; a persistent low-double-digit DAUq decline is the bear path and the base already assumes no recovery of the lost logged-out traffic
US DAUq (-2% y/y) carries ~80% of revenue; growth now depends on ARPU, which has limits in ad load and inventory (September delivery shortfalls)
Logged-in pivot execution: reach-for-engagement trade-off could cut traffic before targeting gains arrive
Data-licensing concentration: Google (~$60m/yr) and OpenAI (~$70m/yr est.) renewals unresolved; ~5% of revenue
SBC at 13-15% of revenue and rising in dollars (+57% y/y in Q3); the house/street band is wide
Terminal value is ~half of base EV at a 12% WACC; +/-1pp of terminal growth or WACC moves the base by roughly $10-15/share (see sensitivity)
Ad-market cyclicality: 95% of revenue is discretionary advertising
